reason: Story-level autoreview on FORGE-WIN-3 (post-stage) found 3 verified defects in delegate.py's psutil port: (1) bare signal.SIGKILL references crash the Windows reap path with AttributeError; (2) POSIX children now inherit the blocked SIGTERM/SIGINT mask (preexec_fn unblock was dropped), killing graceful termination; (3) reconcile treats legacy ps-lstart pid_started rows as recycled PIDs and reaps a live legacy writer — should fail closed. Bounded review-fix round before pr_ready; windows CI has not yet proven the reap path.

quality.summary: Story-level autoreview (codex, branch diff vs fd79887) of the FORGE-WIN-3 psutil port ran clean-room in a scratch worktree (evidence ledgers and the deliberate fake-AWS test fixture excluded; FORGE_PROCESS_TOKEN redacted in-bundle for the secret detector — shipped code unchanged). Four findings; three verified real and fixed in lite window Q-0061-61a1 (portable SIGKILL constant for the nt reap path, preexec_fn signal-mask unblock restored on POSIX spawns, legacy ps-lstart pid_started rows now fail closed in reconcile instead of reaping a live writer). The fourth (environ-unreadable fallback on macOS) was verified NOT a regression — the pre-psutil /proc and ps-eww paths also skipped unreadable environs by design. Two earlier stage-level runs surfaced the doctor --fix user-site convergence bug (fixed + lesson ledgered) plus two confirmed review-target artifacts.

non_blocking_findings.summary: bare signal.SIGKILL crashed the nt reap path — FIXED: module constant SIGKILL = getattr(signal,'SIGKILL',None)
POSIX children inherited the blocked SIGTERM/SIGINT mask after preexec_fn was dropped — FIXED: restored in the POSIX spawn branch only
reconcile reaped a live pre-upgrade writer whose pid_started was ps-lstart format — FIXED: non-float identity fails closed
doctor --fix psutil re-import false-failed same-run after a fresh user-scope install — FIXED: site.addsitedir + invalidate_caches; lesson ledgered

residual_risks: windows-hook-gates on PR #100 is the only real-Windows execution of the launch/reap path; pr_ready waits for it (WIN-2 lesson)
macOS environ() visibility limits the detached-worker token sweep to what the pre-psutil ps-eww path could also see — parity, not regression; children(recursive=True) remains the primary reap
quality.recommendation: ship once windows-hook-gates is green on PR #100

performance.summary: Performance lens of the story autoreview pass. The psutil port enumerates PIDs only (process_iter() bare) and reads environ/cmdline lazily per candidate, so the token sweep does O(candidates) syscalls instead of a bulk environ fetch — verified live against a 2040-process macOS table with no crash and no measurable delegate latency change. Termination keeps the poll/escalate cadence (PROCESS_POLL_SECONDS 0.02, 5s TERM→KILL) unchanged. doctor --fix adds one site.addsitedir call post-install (one-shot). No hot-path regressions found.

non_blocking_findings.summary: per-candidate lazy environ()/cmdline() bounds sweep cost to baseline-diff candidates; full-table eager fetch removed with the ps shell-outs

residual_risks: psutil process_iter on very large Windows process tables is unmeasured locally; windows-hook-gates exercises the real path

security.summary: Security lens of the story autoreview pass. PID-reuse protection is preserved end to end: create_time() identity is captured at spawn, compared adjacent to every signal (batch snapshots rejected), and reconcile now FAILS CLOSED on a legacy or unparseable recorded identity instead of reaping an unverified process. The token sweep proves ownership (username match) before any command-line fallback, and unreadable environs are skipped, never trusted. No user-global config writes; elevation stays deferred per 0040/D-0021. doctor --fix never uses --break-system-packages and surfaces PEP-668 refusals honestly.

non_blocking_findings.summary: legacy pid_started rows fail closed in reconcile (fixed this round) — no signal is ever sent to an identity Forge cannot verify

residual_risks: same-user malicious processes could spoof the FORGE_PROCESS_TOKEN cmdline marker to get adopted into a reap set — bounded to termination of the attacker's own process; delegation/proof commands are trusted inputs per AGENTS.md
orchestrated elevation remains deferred (0040/D-0021); workspace-write is the recorded sandbox
security.recommendation: no security blockers; elevation class stays deferred by decision
